messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime.gen.p99 (hosted-us-west1) crossed 1.5s for 5m on streaming endpoints (/v1/chat/stream, /v1/streaming/generate). Pager triggered.
jordan_oncall: On it. Pulling traces and infra metrics. Paging SRE and Ops rotations.
incident-bot: Pager sent to @jordan_oncall, @ben_sre, @maya_ops.
ben_sre: Initial signal: tail latency spike correlates with a surge of persistent streaming connections holding large KV caches live. KV eviction is lagging and some hosts show token generation stalls.
maya_ops: Frontend proxies show many half-open keepalives and elevated socket queues. NVMe IO wait elevated on model-hosts. Looks like small-chunk streaming sessions are causing eviction churn.
alice_prod: Customers seeing timeouts. I'll notify the impacted accounts. Need mitigation plan and ETA.
jordan_oncall: Proposal: temporarily disable streaming frame/protobuf streaming responses for free+standard in us-west1 and force fallback to non-streaming responses for those tiers only. Keep enterprise and dedicated unchanged. Quick canary, then region rollout. Also apply temporary per-org ingress caps for streaming routes. Monitoring targets: runtime.gen.p95/p99, proxy 5xx, open connection count, kv_eviction_rate.
ben_sre: I'll execute feature flag canary on 2 gateway shards (gw-2, gw-5) then roll. Canary window 30s to watch metrics. Command (ops-internal):
```
# disable streaming for free/standard in us-west1
POST /api/v1/flags/streaming_enabled/rollout
Auth: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN
payload: {"region":"us-west1","tiers":["free","standard"],"value":false}
```
maya_ops: And adding a conservative rate limit for streaming endpoints for non-enterprise in the region to blunt bursts while we evaluate: 40 req/min/org.
```
# attach rate limit for streaming routes in us-west1
POST /api/v1/ratelimits
Auth: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN
payload: {"route":"/v1/*stream*","region":"us-west1","scope":"org","limit":40,"window_seconds":60,"targets":["free","standard"]}
```
ben_sre: Canary started on gw-2 and gw-5 (2/10). Watching. ETA ~45s.
incident-bot: Canary rollout in progress on gw-2, gw-5.
maya_ops: Early canary observations: connection counts on those shards dropped ~55%, p99 dropped from ~1.6s to ~380ms, proxy 5xxs decreased markedly. NVMe wait improving on hosts behind those shards.
ben_sre: Rolling to remaining gateways in us-west1. Change id: fk-2026-03-15-rapid-disable.
incident-bot: Feature flag rollout complete across 10/10 gw in us-west1. Rate limits active. Logged to INC-812.
bennote: Observability queries to keep an eye on: frontend.conn.count{region:us-west1,tier:free}, runtime.gen.p95,p99{region:us-west1}, model.kv.eviction_rate, proxy.5xx_rate.
ben_sre: Post-mitigation snapshot: p95 ~140ms, p99 ~320ms, 5xx dropped ~80%, open connections -60%, kv_eviction_rate normalized.
maya_ops: I've adjusted the autoscaler min_replicas to avoid noisy upscales while the flag is live; will revert once stable. Also applying kernel tcp_keepalive tweaks on proxies as a medium-term follow-up.
alice_prod: Sent interim message to affected customers: "Temporary change: streaming responses are disabled in us-west1 for Free/Standard to stabilize latency. You will still receive full unary responses. We expect recovery and re-enable within 1-3 hours; updates pushed as we progress." 4 customers acked, 1 requested SLA impact detail (escalating).
cust-signal-bot: Notified CSMs for top impacted accounts. 2 customers replied with logs; forwarding to eng.
jordan_oncall: Marking mitigation successful for now. Next steps / owners:
 - SRE (ben_sre): deep-dive into KV cache retention and eviction tuning.
 - Ops (maya_ops): proxy keepalive and NVMe contention fixes.
 - Product (alice_prod): re-evaluate streaming defaults and SDK guidance on session chunking/backoff.
 - Runtime (eng-runtime): investigate streaming path memory/queue behavior.
ben_sre: Creating INC-812-FOLLOWUP with graphs and traces. Will attach flamegraphs for the spike window and KV histograms.
jordan_oncall: Handoff: I'm off at 03:30 PDT. Handing to @nina_oncall. Rollback criteria for re-enable: sustained p99 < 350ms and 5xx rate < 0.15% for a continuous 15m window, and no regression on dedicated/enterprise tenants.
nina_oncall: Ack, I'll take ownership in PagerDuty and keep monitor dashboards up. Please add runbook links and ticket references.
ben_sre: Added runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/streaming-mitigation and ticket INC-812.
incident-bot: Status update: mitigation applied, severity set to SEV-3. Last action logged at 1797630400.
jordan_oncall: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule postmortem and list out action items for long-term fixes. :thumbsup:
